title: No Evidence for [C II] Halos or High-velocity Outflows in z ≳ 6 Quasar Host Galaxies
question: Do z>~6 quasar host galaxies show extended [C II] / dust halos or high-velocity [C II] outflows, tested with uv-plane stacking of ~1 kpc resolution ALMA data of 27 hosts?

recipe.method: Default pipeline restoration scripts in the original CASA version; datasets with wrong Ceres/Pallas models recalibrated; full pipeline rerun in CASA 5.6.1-8 as a flux-scale check
key_parameters: Original CASA 4.1 to 5.4.0-68; recheck with CASA 5.6.1-8

recipe.goal: image each source and cycle, subtract continuum, make [C II] maps
recipe.method: tclean per source/cycle (Högbom, robust 0.5, 30 MHz channels), uvcontsub continuum subtraction, [C II] intensity map from channels over 1.2xFWHM
key_parameters: robust = 0.5; clean to 2 sigma within 2 arcsec radius mask
uvcontsub with fitorder = 1, excluding 2.5xFWHM around the line
assumptions: Gaussian line profile when correcting for the tails beyond 1.2xFWHM (factor 1.19)

recipe.goal: measure aperture fluxes with residual scaling and uv-plane diagnostics
recipe.method: Circular-aperture fluxes from dirty, residual and clean-component maps with residual scaling; imfit 2D Gaussians in image plane; uvmodelfit and radially averaged visibility amplitudes in the uv-plane
key_parameters: Corrected flux F = C + eps R = eps D, eps = C/(D-R) in the aperture
Aperture error approximated by rms x sqrt(N beams)
assumptions: Apertures chosen manually at the radius where the curve of growth flattens

recipe.goal: extract aperture spectra and stack them in velocity/sigma_line units
recipe.method: Residual-scaled aperture flux per channel, Gaussian plus constant fit, spectra rescaled by line width, constant continuum subtracted, stacked without weights
assumptions: Continuum flat within the bandwidth of interest

recipe.goal: prepare and image the uv-stacked data
recipe.method: Split channels from continuum-subtracted visibilities, time-average to 30 s, set ICRS, phase-shift to the [C II] centroid with fixvis, recompute weights with statwt, then tclean (mfs, multi-scale) all sources together; each velocity bin imaged separately and joined with ia.imageconcat
key_parameters: specmode = mfs; multi-scale scales 0, 1, 3, 5, 10 beams; 2 arcsec radius mask to 2 sigma
Velocity bins of fixed 30 km/s or 0.2 sigma_line; channels chosen with im.advisechansel in LSRK, nearest neighbour
assumptions: Recomputed weights comparable across datasets so no single source dominates the average

recipe.goal: measure spatial extent of stacked [C II] and dust emission
recipe.method: Curve of growth and azimuthally averaged surface brightness profile of the uv-stacked [C II] map and continuum map (clean sample); half-light radius at 50% of flux at 10 kpc; exponential fit to the extended component
key_parameters: No residual scaling used for the profile; mean pixel value in annuli, since corrections are negligible
assumptions: Extended component described by an exponential function

recipe.goal: search the stacked spectrum for a broad (outflow) component
recipe.method: uv-stacked cube of the clean (and full) sample in 0.2 sigma_line slices; 2 arcsec aperture and single-beam spectra fit with one Gaussian; residuals inspected; wings map stacked between 3 and 6 sigma_line; upper limit from wings rms
key_parameters: 100 slices of 0.2 sigma_line covering +-10 sigma_line; sigma_line = 150 km/s
assumptions: 3 sigma upper limit derived from the wings-map rms and its bandwidth

recipe.goal: compare extended dust profile with MassiveFIRE simulation
recipe.method: Stack predicted 1.2 mm ALMA maps of simulated galaxies and average in radial annuli; compare with observed profiles
key_parameters: Simulated halos of (2-6)x10^12 Msun, SFR 70-400 Msun/yr, total IR luminosity ~1e12 Lsun matched to the sample
assumptions: SMBH feedback does not severely affect the host at radii beyond 2 kpc; simulated galaxies matched in FIR luminosity only

score_reason: Scale 1-5. Data and the multi-step recipe (uv-stacking, residual scaling, profile measurement) are described in good detail with quoted numbers, but many tclean and aperture settings are unstated and the heavy data volume plus inherited choices from companion papers make exact reproduction hard.
rediscovery_reason: ALMA data of cycles 1-6 for the 13 listed projects are known to be public in the archive; the recipe is mostly complete and results (half-light radii, fluxes, rms, outflow limit) are numeric, though reproduction is data-heavy.
